verified_facts.text: Hotel del Coronado is a 28-acre beachfront destination.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hotel del Coronado is a 28‑acre beachfront destination

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are spread across three neighborhoods: the Victorian, the Cabanas and the Views.
verified_facts.excerpt: rooms and suites available in three distinct neighborhoods: the iconic Victorian, the lively Cabanas, and the contemporary Views

verified_facts.text: The Victorian is the original beachfront hotel, established in 1888.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Victorian is the original, iconic beachfront hotel established in 1888

verified_facts.text: The Victorian is a restored National Historic Landmark.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take a journey through time in this lovingly restored National Historic Landmark.

verified_facts.text: In the Victorian, no two rooms are alike.
verified_facts.excerpt: no two rooms are alike, and all are full of character.

verified_facts.text: Victorian rooms have a private bathroom with walk-in shower and Victorian-era interior design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inside, enjoy a private bathroom with walk-in shower and an interior design that celebrates the beauty of the Victorian era.

verified_facts.text: The Cabanas sits at the heart of the resort with a central pool, beachfront access and fireside terraces.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Cabanas places you at the heart of the resort, with a vibrant central pool, coveted beachfront access, and fireside terraces

verified_facts.text: Cabanas guests choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as a private cabana.
verified_facts.excerpt: Choose between a beachside room with a terrace and fire pit or a poolside room that serves as your private cabana

verified_facts.text: The Views offers rooms and suites with front-row access to the Pacific.

verified_facts.text: Club Access rooms include daily breakfast, beach chairs and umbrella, seasonal Beach Club access and curated afternoon bites.
